args.title: Adjacency count
args.description: Each safe cell shows the number of mines among its up to eight neighbours.
args.given_when_then: Given a game with mines placed and a safe cell at a position When the mine layout is fixed Then the cell's adjacent_mine_count equals the number of mines in its up to eight neighbouring cells.

args.title: Zero expansion
args.description: A revealed cell with count 0 reveals all neighbours, recursively.
args.given_when_then: Given a hidden cell with adjacent_mine_count 0 in an in-progress game When the player reveals it Then all its neighbouring hidden cells are revealed and any neighbour with count 0 continues the expansion recursively.

args.title: Zero expansion stops at numbered cells
args.description: Expansion does not reveal past cells with a non-zero count, and does not reveal flagged cells.
args.given_when_then: Given a zero-count reveal that reaches a neighbour with count greater than 0 or a flagged neighbour When expansion runs Then that neighbour is revealed only if hidden and not flagged, and expansion does not continue beyond it.

args.title: First-click safety
args.description: The first reveal is never a mine, and its neighbours are mine-free; the layout is fixed at that moment.
args.given_when_then: Given a game in ready status When the first cell is revealed Then mines are placed so that the revealed cell and all its neighbours have has_mine false, and the layout is fixed.

args.title: Flag placement on hidden cells
args.description: Flags may be placed only on hidden cells.
args.given_when_then: Given an in-progress game and a hidden cell When the player flags it Then the cell state becomes flagged and flag_count increases by one; Given a revealed cell When the player flags it Then the board is unchanged.

args.title: Flag removal
args.description: Flags may be removed at any time while in progress; flagged cells cannot be revealed.
args.given_when_then: Given a flagged cell in an in-progress game When the player removes the flag Then the cell returns to hidden and flag_count decreases by one; Given a flagged cell When the player attempts to reveal it Then the cell remains flagged and is not revealed.

args.title: Right-click cycle
args.description: Right-click cycles hidden to flagged to hidden; question marks are not included.
args.given_when_then: Given a hidden cell When the player right-clicks it Then it becomes flagged; Given a flagged cell When the player right-clicks it Then it becomes hidden; Given a revealed cell When right-clicked Then it is unchanged.

args.title: Mine counter may go negative
args.description: Mine counter shows total mines minus flags placed and may be negative.
args.given_when_then: Given a game with mine_count M and flag_count F When the counter is displayed Then it shows M minus F, including negative values when F exceeds M.

args.title: Loss on mine reveal
args.description: Revealing a mine ends the session as lost; all mines are shown and wrong flags are marked.
args.given_when_then: Given an in-progress game When the player reveals a mine Then status becomes lost, ended_at is set, all mine cells are shown as revealed, and flagged cells without mines are marked as wrong.

args.title: Win on all safe cells revealed
args.description: Session is won when every non-mine cell is revealed; remaining unrevealed mines are auto-flagged.
args.given_when_then: Given an in-progress game When the last non-mine cell is revealed Then status becomes won, ended_at is set, and every unrevealed mine cell becomes flagged.

args.title: Terminal state rejects changes
args.description: No reveal or flag changes are accepted after won or lost; only restart is allowed.
args.given_when_then: Given a game in won or lost status When the player reveals or flags any cell Then the board and status are unchanged; When the player restarts Then a new game is created.

args.title: Timer starts on first reveal
args.description: Timer starts on first reveal, not before.
args.given_when_then: Given a game in ready status When the first cell is revealed Then started_at is set and elapsed time begins; Given a game in ready status When a flag is placed Then the timer does not start.

args.title: Timer stops at session end
args.description: Timer stops at win or loss.
args.given_when_then: Given an in-progress game When the session is won or lost Then elapsed_seconds is fixed at the value at that moment and no longer increases.

args.title: Timer display cap
args.description: Timer is capped at 999 seconds for display.
args.given_when_then: Given elapsed time greater than 999 seconds When the timer is displayed Then it shows 999.

args.title: Invalid operations ignored
args.description: Acting on revealed cells, after game end, or outside the board is ignored without changing state.
args.given_when_then: Given any game state When the player reveals a revealed cell, acts after game end, or targets a position outside the board Then the board and session state are unchanged.

args.title: Restart resets session
args.description: Starting a new game discards the current board and timer and returns to ready.
args.given_when_then: Given a game in any status When the player starts a new game at a chosen difficulty Then a new board is created with status ready, elapsed time zero, and no mine layout fixed.

args.title: Difficulty grid and mine count
args.description: Three difficulties define board size and mine count.
args.given_when_then: Given a player starting a game When Beginner is chosen Then the board is 9x9 with 10 mines; Intermediate yields 16x16 with 40 mines; Expert yields 30x16 with 99 mines.

args.title: Board edge boundaries
args.description: Neighbour computation at board edges and corners counts only in-board cells.
args.given_when_then: Given a cell on the board edge or corner When adjacency is computed Then only neighbours inside the board are counted, giving fewer than eight neighbours.

args.title: Grid cell presentation
args.description: Board looks like classic Minesweeper: raised grey hidden tiles, flat light grey revealed tiles, numbers coloured as original (1 blue, 2 green, 3 red).
args.given_when_then: Given a revealed cell with count 1 When the board is rendered Then the tile is flat light grey and the number is blue.

args.title: Flag and header presentation
args.description: Flags render red; the header shows mine counter, timer, and a restart control.
args.given_when_then: Given a flagged cell When rendered Then a red flag is shown; Given a game in progress When the header is rendered Then mine counter, timer and restart button are visible above the grid.
